_comment: Generic MCP registration for a client process running on the WINDOWS HOST
while the build toolchain lives in WSL. Replace WSL_REPO with the repo path
/mnt/c/Users/you/Documents/SOTN-Decomp) and DISTRO with your distro name.
If your client already runs INSIDE WSL, use mcp_servers.native.json instead.
It is faster and has one less quoting layer to get wrong.
WHY SOTN_CMD_DRYRUN IS INLINE IN THE BASH STRING AND NOT IN env:
MCP env entries are applied to the wsl.exe process on the Windows side and
do NOT cross into WSL unless they are named in WSLENV. When they were in env
the server saw nothing, and because DRYRUN fails closed on an unset value it
did not run live -- but the operator could not turn dry-run OFF either, and
the reason was invisible. Passing it inline in the command is the fix.
SOTN_CMD_MAXOUT is inline for the same reason.
